:::{#exr-transpose-practice}
#### Writing one observation as a row vector

A data table stores each observation as a row,
so an observation held as a [column vector](#def-column-vector)
is written in the table as its [transpose](#def-transpose).
Let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{4 \\ -1 \\ 0}.
$$

Find $\tp{\vx}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-transpose,
keep the entries in the same order
and write them horizontally.

:::

:::
